horoscope: Good energy is with you today for creative problem-solving, dear Aries. You're better able to help people understand your point of view today. You also seem to be able to reach mutually beneficial agreements. A pleasant intensity colors the day, no matter your focus. It’s a good time for connecting and sharing ideas, and in fact, you can gain quite a bit of ground in a friendship now. You want to grow, and you’re not content with the ordinary now. Emotional engagement and more profound interactions are favored today.

Business strategy can thrive, and relationship matters benefit from further thought today, dear Taurus. You may feel a strong need to produce, engage with your work, and strategize. Today is excellent for nurturing and enjoying your ambitious side. With the Moon's move into your work and health sector, you're also ready to put in the work. You can feel an unusually strong need to put things in their proper places. Fortunately, you have an intuitive understanding of how to use your skills or talents to your benefit right now.

Emotional honesty and willingness to recognize others as integral to your success and fulfillment are in focus today, dear Gemini. You’re also in the frame of mind to organize and handle details. This is also a strong day for enjoying learning and developing your skills or knowledge. It’s a good time for taking a break to refresh and rejuvenate yourself, either by doing the things you most enjoy or sidestepping the things that leave you drained. A belief system is forming or transforming now, and you find it fascinating and motivating.

With today’s transits, dear Cancer, your ability to listen and make others feel interesting and at ease is strong. It’s a great time to solve problems. While a desire to stick close to home or decompress and relax grabs hold partway through the day, you remain deeply fascinated with a workable idea, project, or mystery to solve. You’re interested in exploring a topic further, and you’re in great shape for bringing something to a new level, whether this is an idea or a relationship. You’re feeling pleasantly ambitious.

Transits today support creative, rewarding relating, dear Leo. Your sense of harmony and balance is powerful. You can begin the day craving predictability and end it demanding stimulation. The Moon moves from a secure, stable area of your chart to a busy, mentally active one, and this is one reason for this shift. Another is a Pluto-Juno aspect, and the desire for just a little more from a relationship or project is with you. You’re bound to shake things up so that life doesn’t become dull. Of course, you should be careful what you wish for on this level. Try not to push things too far or someone’s buttons too hard! Fortunately, your intuition is powerful right now.

Today is good for problem-solving and bringing more engagement and balance to your routines, dear Virgo. The day can begin with vigor, as you crave a stronger connection with the world around you, feedback, and emotional interaction or acknowledgment. However, the Moon moves out of your sign and into your resources sector, and you may want to set some of these feelings aside so you can focus more on the practical side of your life, or simply enjoy a quieter, more predictable pace. Even so, you never entirely lose your need for a more profound attachment to your projects, ventures, or people in your life today. Work and health matters may gain traction, or you enjoy deeper ambition and motivation to improve them.

Today is powerful for communicating and sharing creatively, dear Libra. Your ideas are inventive. You’re likely to crave time to yourself, or at least a bit of space to recoup your energy and spirit, as you begin the day. However, as the day advances, you seek out more interaction and passion. For one, the Moon enters your sign, igniting your emotions. For another, Pluto and Juno align in your sector of heartfelt pursuits, and this is an ambitious combination. You feel more certain about what you want and more sure of your next moves. It's powerful for ideas and enthusiasm for a person or project. Whatever you’re doing now, you’re pouring your heart into it.

Good energy is with you for problem-solving with business, financial, and practical affairs today, dear Scorpio. You crave more involvement or attachment to a project, idea, or person. Strategy is fun and useful now. This is also a strong day for enjoying pleasant ambition for home and family activities and improvements. Your personal appeal and drive are powerful. Still, the Moon heads into your solar twelfth house, and winding down makes some sense. You’re in good shape for activities that help you heal and repair.

Today is good for cooperative efforts, especially where it concerns communications, dear Sagittarius. Your social life, sense of community, or personal happiness is becoming a bigger priority. Even so, intensity doesn’t fade, it just redirects, as the day advances. You are in a fabulous position for building ambition and passion for a project or personal interest. Close relationships can thrive with honesty and intensity. An equal distribution of power is most appealing to you right now.

Cooperation brings the most rewards today, dear Capricorn. You may have information others don’t, giving you an ace up your sleeve. You begin the day feeling rather adventurous and not wanting to feel tied down to any one thing. However, as the day advances, your ambition builds. You are in a great position to strategize and design plans. Today's transits are bringing out your enjoyment of creating a master plan. This is also a good day for getting in touch with what you truly need or value.

Today’s transits are strong for working through tricky areas and the balance of power, dear Aquarius. Still, you crave emotional excitement or engagement. While you do run a slight risk of overload, this can otherwise be a powerful and even magical day as you feel pleasantly ambitious and personally confident. You’re attracting like-minded people into your life or enjoying connections that help you clarify your goals. Your eye may be on something all-new or independent, as you're a self-starter right now.

Today is good for considering goals and devising strategies, dear Pisces. The day can be rather other-focused, but despite your sociable mood, you are in great shape for working out a personal problem or taking part in activities that help you heal or decompress and unwind. Unraveling a mystery from your past may figure strongly. You don’t need to know everything to put something behind you, but it helps to have some insight, and this is possible now.
